declarations.name: AuiCodeViewer

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the code region.

inputs.name: code
inputs.description: Source text (ignored when diff is set).

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: Show a diff: { original, modified, mode?: 'unified' | 'split', originalLabel?, modifiedLabel?, ignoreWhitespace? }.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: File name shown in the toolbar.

inputs.name: startLine
inputs.description: Number of the first line (code view).

inputs.name: highlightLines
inputs.description: Line numbers or [from, to] ranges to highlight (modified line numbers in a diff).

inputs.name: toolbar
inputs.description: Show the toolbar (file name, language, actions).

inputs.name: maxHeight
inputs.description: Maximum block size of the scroll area (CSS length), or null to grow with the content (no virtualization).

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Toolbar icons: copy, copied, unified, split.

inputs.name: wrap
inputs.description: Wrap long lines (the side-by-side diff always wraps).

inputs.name: tabSize
inputs.description: Width of a tab character in spaces (1 to 16).

outputs.name: copied
outputs.description: The text was written to the clipboard: { text }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user toggled wrapping or the diff mode: { wrap, mode, reason }.

methods.name: scrollToLine
methods.description: Scroll a displayed line number (modified side in a diff) into view.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copy the text to the clipboard; resolves false when the clipboard refused.

accessibility.pattern: A focusable, named scroll region (role=region) containing the code as text; toolbar actions are native toggle and push buttons.

limitations: A fixed set of languages; embedded scripts and styles inside HTML are shown as plain text.
Regular expression literals in JavaScript are not highlighted.
The side-by-side diff always wraps long lines.
